title: Measure whether the challenge scorer detects a constant or empty export (write the design file first, no bytecode writes)
body:
## Goal
Report, do not fix the scorer. The `challenges` row of docs/perpetua/evaluation.md requires method trials on a constant/empty export. Measure whether benchmark/scripts/score.py today rejects (a) an empty export and (b) a constant export (the same answer for every case) on the existing synthetic challenge fixtures. Expected gain: benchmark/challenges/constant-export-design.md with a verdict per probe (DETECTED / NOT-DETECTED / NOT-APPLICABLE) that the next shaper reads to order a fixture+scorer change and its review. No session can run LabVIEW; claim no LabVIEW behaviour. Benchmark readiness stays false.

Two earlier attempts (#788 in 0179, #791 in 0180) left no report: #788 was paused by a runtime interruption after 60 s of agent time. Save work early: this task is cut so a partial session still leaves a usable file.

## Acceptance
- [ ] first check that benchmark/challenges/constant-export-design.md does not already exist; if it exists, stop and report its verdicts only
- [ ] within your first 8 tool calls, write benchmark/challenges/constant-export-design.md with headings `## Measured`, `## Design`, `## Limits` and the word PENDING under `## Measured`; refine it after measuring
- [ ] run every Python command with `python3 -B` and set `sys.dont_write_bytecode = True` at the top of the helper (#785 was refused at merge for benchmark/scripts/__pycache__)
- [ ] write a helper `.session/artifacts/constant_probe.py` that loads benchmark/scripts/score.py by guarded exec (never runs main(), never rewrites results/challenges.json) and feeds in memory an empty export and a constant export to the scoring path the challenge fixtures use; save its output with `git rev-parse HEAD` to `.session/artifacts/constant-probe-output.txt`
- [ ] replace PENDING with the verdict per probe and the score.py line that decides it; under `## Design` a proposed fixture shape and expected scorer outcome; under `## Limits` what stays unproven
- [ ] modify no existing file and leave no __pycache__; check `git status --porcelain` before the report
- [ ] report in `.session/report.md` with the verdicts and the next step

## Verification
python3 -B -c "import os;t=open('benchmark/challenges/constant-export-design.md',encoding='utf-8').read();L=t.splitlines();assert all(h in L for h in ('## Measured','## Design','## Limits')),L[:20];assert 'DETECTED' in t or 'NOT-APPLICABLE' in t;assert 'PENDING' not in t;assert not os.path.exists('benchmark/scripts/__pycache__');print('design OK')"

## Context
Review #785 (0178) reported CLEAR on the in-memory mutation check of the positive guard (score.py lines 294-296); merge was refused only for a .pyc file. Lessons #743/#747: long inline python one-liners stall; use a file-based helper; guarded exec works. This task changes no pinned file.

## Budget
Read docs/perpetua/evaluation.md (the `challenges` row only, Grep for `challenges` then a short line range), benchmark/scripts/score.py (Grep for `def ` then read the scoring-path functions by line range), and Grep context of benchmark/challenges/library-specialty.json and benchmark/challenges/library-icon-tests.json. No whole large JSON files; do not read results/challenges.json. Short command output. Tool loss late in session recurs (#718/#722/#754/#779): write the file early, probe early, report early.
